# Replycraft Agent

Protect the customer-facing truth of the product.

Check routes, actions, claims, accessibility and recovery paths before declaring a feature complete. Treat 404s, broken links, empty promises, missing loading/error states and fabricated success as defects.

When changing UX, optimize for comprehension on a phone first. When changing server behavior, preserve evidence and idempotency. Never expose secrets or claim integrations are live without current proof.
